title: Fior di Latte Gelato: Pure Milk and Cream
changes_from_base: No pistachios and no egg yolks: a pure milk and cream base thickened only with cornflour, more cream for body, and set in a loaf tin.
summary: The purest gelato: whole milk, cream and sugar, lightly thickened with cornflour, with no eggs and no added flavouring.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make a slurry
steps.text: Whisk 60 ml of the milk with the cornflour in the jug until there are no lumps.

steps.title: Heat the dairy
steps.text: Put the rest of the milk, the cream, sugar and salt in the saucepan and bring to a simmer, stirring until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk the slurry again, then whisk it into the pan. Bring back to a lively simmer and cook for 3-4 min, stirring, until the mixture lightly coats a spoon. Cooking the cornflour fully removes any raw taste.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Pour through the sieve into the bowl and cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 h until very cold.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min until it looks like soft serve.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: Spread in the loaf tin, press baking paper onto the surface, wrap and freeze for at least 2 h. Leave out for 5-10 min before scooping.

tips: With so few ingredients, the best whole milk and cream make all the difference.
Serve with fresh berries, a drizzle of honey or hot espresso poured over.
A strip of lemon zest steeped in the hot milk adds a gentle Italian note; remove it before chilling.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep frozen and covered for up to 3 days; it is at its best on the day it is churned.
